Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,408 million.

entries.ac4c10e4ef818f20: This business operates advertising media centered on the comparison site "Hikaku.com". On "Hikaku.com", information on products and services in various fields such as shopping, providers, travel and asset management is organized and provided in line with the needs of internet users, and services such as document requests, quote requests, applications, reservations and purchase referrals are also offered. Income mainly consists of fixed monthly advertising income and performance-based advertising income. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥5 million.
